Messages.Author: Intimate apperal
Messages.Body:
My opponent went and played a Tragic Love Affair on Masika. Tragic Love
Affair says "Does not untap as normal during the untap phase" My question
is can Masika untap between turns - his card says he can.

-tony, Prince of Iowa City

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
Intimate apperal <abr...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu> writes:

>My opponent went and played a Tragic Love Affair on Masika. Tragic Love
>Affair says "Does not untap as normal during the untap phase" My question

>is can Masika untap between turns - his card says he can.

Of course. TLA limits untaps as normal - per the card - not extra untap
from powers or cards or such.

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Intimate apperal <abr...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu> writes:

>My opponent went and played a Tragic Love Affair on Masika. Tragic Love
>Affair says "Does not untap as normal during the untap phase" My question
>is can Masika untap between turns - his card says he can.

Of course. That's why it says "as normal" and "during untap" - so that
these questions won't come up.

Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
Yes, Masika could untap between Meths. turns. Just remember to untap him
before it's your turn, because if he is tapped going into your turn, he
would not untap as normal.

stephen

Messages.Author: Damian Chang
Messages.Body:
:In article <Pine.A32.3.91.950402...@black.weeg.uiowa.edu>, Intimate apperal <abr...@blue.weeg.uiowa.edu> writes:
:> My opponent went and played a Tragic Love Affair on Masika. Tragic Love
:> Affair says "Does not untap as normal during the untap phase" My question
:> is can Masika untap between turns - his card says he can.

Yes, playing TLA on Masika does not do anything as he untaps between your
predator's turn and yours.
